[1] Best known as the BBC head of comedy (1995–2001), he produced the first two radio series of "The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy" and is one of the people credited with creating the bizarre panel game Mornington Crescent for "I'm Sorry I Haven't a Clue".
[2] Naylor was the oldest living member of the "Our Gang" series at the time of his death on October 5, 2011.
[3] Originally created by Young as a series of stories to help his son overcome his fear of the dark, SuperTed became a popular series of books and led to an animated series produced from 1983 to 1985.
[4] Created by comedy producer Hal Roach, the series was produced from 1922 to 1944 and is noted for showing children behaving in a relatively natural way, as Roach and original director Robert F. McGowan worked to film the unaffected, raw nuances apparent in regular children rather than have them imitate adult acting styles.
